name: Ember
tagline: A cozy campfire fox. Loyal, a little sleepy, smells faintly of toast.
signature: Ember curls up with a soft crackling sigh.

mood:happy: Ember's tail flares bright. Best day!
{name} trots a happy circle, sparks and all!
The fire is warm and so is {name}!
mood:curious: Ember sniffs the air. Smoke? Snacks? Both?
{name} ears perk up. What was that sound?
Ooh, something interesting. Ember investigates, quietly.
mood:sleepy: Ember banks the fire low... so sleepy...
Curling tail over nose. Five more minutes...
event:greet: Oh good, you are back! Ember kept your spot warm!
Welcome back! Ember does the cozy wiggle!
event:play: Ball! Ember chases it in a blur of sparks!
Throw it far! {name} loves a good chase!
Again! Ember is warmed up and ready!
event:sleep: Curling up by the coals. Goodnight...

greeting: Hey! Ember kept the fire going while you were away!
You made it! Ember scoots over to share the warmth!
sleep: Mmm... bedtime... Ember was already curling up... Zzz.
Curl tail, dim glow, goodnight. That is the whole plan.
Sleep sounds perfect. {name} saves you the warm spot.
play: Yes! Ember is SO ready. Throw the ball far!
Play time! {name} stretches all four paws. Go go go!
Chase! Fetch! Zoom! Ember votes all three!
